THE GILT CHANGE, AND WHY IT RESTS ON OUR OWN SERIES
  This feed's previous-close field for the gilt has drifted again: it read 5.3299 yesterday and
  5.3612 today, which cannot both be Thursday's close. Friday's closing LEVEL of 5.3693 is agreed by
  both providers. The +0.04 day-move published here is the move we read ourselves at 16:17 on Friday
  (5.3682 against a previous close of 5.3299) and is consistent with our own published series. TE's
  change field today reads -0.004%, which is meaningless with the market shut. Declared rather than
  silently chosen.
